title: Software Developer (Core Engineering)
description: We are seeking a versatile Software Developer to design, build, and maintain mission-critical software services. You will write clean, well-tested code, collaborate with product managers, and participate in code reviews.
responsibilities: Write robust, maintainable code using Python, Java, or C++.
Design and implement RESTful APIs and integrate backend relational databases.
Write automated unit tests and participate in team agile sprint planning.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to software architecture improvements.
requirements: 2+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or C++ and object-oriented design.
Familiarity with Git, Linux command line, and SQL relational databases.
Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and unit testing.
